page.overview:
What is Compound?

Compounds are a type of item from Education Edition used in chemistry, which are created from combinations of various elements.

Compounds cannot be obtained in the Creative inventory. They are only obtained from creating them in the compound creator. This is done by inserting a certain number of elements corresponding to the compound's chemical formula.
